_comment: Exact model revisions this deployment is known to work with.
Without these, a re-download silently pulls whatever upstream is current,
so a rebuilt machine can get different weights than the one that was tested.
Bump deliberately via ./update.sh, never by hand-editing during a fix.
Every entry carries the service it belongs to, its measured size on disk,
and whether it is required. `./anneal models` groups by service and reports
the total before downloading anything: about 32 GB for everything, 11 GB for
a working music-and-speech install. Optionality is not decoration — 40 GB of
models were deleted from this machine after they turned out not to earn it,
and nobody should have to fetch those to try the ones that do.
size_gb is `du -sh` on this install, not the download size. They are close
for weights and the difference is not worth a second number to keep true.

A selection can name a service or a single model — `./anneal models text` or `./anneal models Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-4bit`. Naming a model fetches it whether or not it is optional, because naming it is the decision `required` exists to ask for.

ACE-Step/Ace-Step1.5.note: Bundle: vae, Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, acestep-v15-turbo, acestep-5Hz-lm-1.7B. 3.5 GB of that is the 1.7B planning LM, which this hardware tier never loads — it cannot be dropped without making verify-models.py unhappy about a partial bundle.

ACE-Step/acestep-5Hz-lm-0.6B.note: The planning LM this hardware tier actually uses; the bundled 1.7B is never loaded here

ACE-Step/acestep-v15-sft.note: The 'high' quality tier. Without it, quality=high 503s and draft still works.

mlx-community/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Custom.note: Directed speech — the nine voices that take an `instruct`. Without it those voices 503; Kokoro's 28 are unaffected. Was absent from this lockfile for its whole life, which is what tests/unit/test_models_lock.py now prevents.

dhairyashil/FLUX.1-schnell-mflux-4bit.note: Image. Ungated pre-quantized mirror — black-forest-labs' own repo is gated

akx/FLUX.1-Kontext-dev-mflux-4bit.note: Only for the 'kontext' sprite method, which edits one base sprite per pose instead of cutting a sheet. NON-COMMERCIAL: the weights may not be used commercially without a licence from Black Forest Labs. The default sheet method needs nothing extra.

mlx-community/gemma-4-e4b-it-4bit.note: Text/code generation, served by mlx_lm.server, and what Press uses to plan. Reasoning model — send chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false for direct answers.

stabilityai/stable-audio-3-optimized.note: Free for research and non-commercial use, and for commercial use below US $1M annual revenue; above that it needs a licence from Stability AI. Outputs are your own. Only the sm-sfx bundle is fetched — the repo also holds TensorRT, ONNX and TFLite builds running to about 100 GB, which allow_patterns exists to avoid.

Runpod/FLUX.2-klein-4B-mflux-4bit.note: Only for sprite method 'edit', which generates one base sprite and then edits it once per pose. Optional: the default 'sheet' method needs no model of its own. Measured at 33 s and 4.90 GB peak per frame at 512x512, four steps.

mlx-community/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct-.note: Optional second text model, for code and tool use. Same size as the default and no reasoning preamble to disable. Selected with the OpenAI `model` field.

mlx-community/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-4bi.note: Optional third text model: half the size of the others, for lyric planning and short replies where the wait costs more than the polish.

mlx-community/gpt-oss-20b-MXFP4-Q4.note: Optional text model for agent work. The largest that fits: measured 11.18 GB peak against about 11.8 GB usable unified memory on this 16 GB machine, 28 s to load, 13 tok/s. Faster than the 4.8 GB default despite being 20B, because only a few experts are active per token. Nothing else heavy can be loaded while it is.

ACE-Step/ACE-Step-1.5.note: Cloned to $ACESTEP_DIR by setup.sh. Its own .venv follows the repo's uv.lock and is built by the first `uv run`.
